name: Groomers Gents Salon (Main Branch)
address: Next to Baqer Mohebi Supermarket - Hay Al Nahda - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Groomers Gents Salon is a premium grooming destination in Sharjah, dedicated to providing professional hair and skincare services tailored to the modern man. Our expert team specializes in precision haircuts, classic shaves, and rejuvenating facial treatments designed to help you look and feel your refined best. With a reputation built on consistent quality and meticulous attention to detail, we offer a welcoming environment for your regular grooming routine. Experience professional care in the heart of Sharjah. Book your appointment with us today to elevate your personal style.

reviews.author: Mohammed Yasir
reviews.text:
Overall review ,  Expensive Saloon and pricing inconsistency  .

After I posted my initial review, I received calls and messages from the salon’s administrative team explaining that the keratin treatment for my hair length should normally cost around AED 160–180. However, I was charged AED 315 (AED 300 + AED 15 VAT), which was quite surprising.

Because of this experience, I recommend that customers confirm the exact charges before proceeding with any service to avoid misunderstandings.

I have visited this salon one time only and have done hair
colouring, beard setting, hair styling, and keratin treatment. The staff are professional and the overall service quality is decent. Since it is a premium salon, I understand that prices are slightly higher for regular services like haircut and beard, which are still manageable occasionally.

However, I was honestly disappointed with the keratin treatment pricing. I was charged AED 315 for keratin alone, and the total bill came to AED 493. My hair is not long, and compared to other premium salons in Dubai and AUH where I have paid around AED 190 for similar treatment, this felt excessively expensive.

Because of this, I did not feel fully satisfied with my experience. For keratin treatment especially, I would suggest customers confirm the price clearly in advance. I hope the salon considers reviewing their pricing to make it more reasonable for customers.
reviews.owner_reply:
Hello Mr. Yasser,

Thank you for your feedback. We sincerely apologize for the confusion regarding the keratin treatment pricing during your visit.

After seeing your review, our team had contacted you to clarify that the charge related confusion/understanding or miscommunication was not intentional and since we care a lot about our customer experience , we would want to win you back as a customer and request you to give us another chance to serve you better. As discussed, you are eligible for the amount discussed over the call and can coordinate with Supervisor Sujith for the refund as a goodwill gesture to resolve the matter.

We see that as an experience recovery action . Every customer experience is a learning for us, and we continuously try to identify and improve any loopholes in our processes to ensure better transparency and service.

We understand your disappointment and respect your decision. We also appreciate your kind words about our staff and service. Thank you for your feedback. 🙏

We'd genuinely like the opportunity to make this right. Please reach out to us at 0521786999 at your earliest convenience so we can discuss how we can restore your confidence in our salon. If you'd prefer, please feel free to share your contact number and we'll get back to you promptly.

Best regards,
